theorems.name: Submission.deformation_good_radius
theorems.statement: ∀ (a b : ℝ) (g : ℝ → ℝ≥0∞) (K : ℝ≥0∞) (N : Set ℝ), a < b → Measurable g → ∫⁻ t in Ioo a b, g t ≤ K → volume N = 0 → ∃ t ∈ Ioo a b, t ∉ N ∧ g t ≤ 2 * K / ENNReal.ofReal (b - a)
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
